title: Must the remaining security be returned electronically?

source.quote: No later than 21 calendar days after the tenant has vacated the premises

rule.statement: The landlord received the security or rental payments from the tenant electronically.

source.quote: If the landlord received the security or rental payments from the tenant electronically, the landlord shall return the remainder of the security electronically to a bank account or other financial institution designated by the tenant in writing, or by any electronic or virtual method available to the landlord if agreed to in writing by the tenant.

children.statement: The landlord and tenant designated another method of return by written agreement (a paper writing, or an electronic one meeting CA.electronic-writing).

source.quote: Alternatively, the landlord and tenant may, by written agreement, designate another method of return, including, but not limited to, by personal delivery or by a check made payable to the tenant and mailed by first-class mail, postage prepaid, to an address provided by the tenant.

children.statement: More than one adult tenant resides in the unit.

source.quote: if multiple adult tenants reside in the unit, the landlord shall return the remainder of the security by a check made payable to all adult tenants on the rental or lease agreement at the time the tenancy terminates

child.statement: The landlord and all adult tenants residing in the unit entered a written agreement specifying how the remainder is returned and how each receives the statement.

source.quote: If multiple adult tenants reside in the unit, the landlord may enter into a mutual written agreement between the landlord and all adult tenants, at the commencement of the tenancy or at any time during or after the tenancy, that specifies both of the following:

child.statement: A tenant who ended the lease under Section 1946.7 asked for the security to be disbursed other than by a check payable to all adult tenants.

source.quote: the tenant who terminated the lease pursuant to Section 1946.7 requests that the security be disbursed in a manner other than by check made payable to all adult tenants, the landlord may return the security in a manner other than by check made payable to all adult tenants.

children.statement: For several adult tenants without a written agreement, the check payable to all of them governs even though the landlord received payments electronically.

decision.what: Which refund route to use for several adult tenants who paid electronically without a written agreement among them, accepting the exposure of the other reading.

source.quote: Except as provided in clause (iii) and unless the landlord and all adult tenants residing in the unit enter into a written mutual agreement pursuant to clause (ii), if multiple adult tenants reside in the unit, the landlord shall return the remainder of the security by a check made payable to all adult tenants on the rental or lease agreement at the time the tenancy terminates

effects.statement: Return the remainder electronically to the bank account or other financial institution the tenant designated in writing, or by an electronic or virtual method the tenant agreed to in writing, by day 21. The statute gives no fallback if the tenant never designates an account; Handoff asks for the designation on the tenant page.

source.quote: If the landlord received the security or rental payments from the tenant electronically, the landlord shall return the remainder of the security electronically to a bank account or other financial institution designated by the tenant in writing, or by any electronic or virtual method available to the landlord if agreed to in writing by the tenant.

contested.question: Where several adult tenants reside, paid electronically and signed no written agreement among them, does the check payable to all of them displace the electronic-refund duty?

branches.reading: Yes. Subparagraph (C)(i) applies whenever several adult tenants reside, unless all of them sign the clause (ii) agreement; that agreement is how an electronic deposit to each tenant's account becomes available. The electronic duty cannot be performed for one undesignated payee among several.

authority.quote: Except as provided in clause (iii) and unless the landlord and all adult tenants residing in the unit enter into a written mutual agreement pursuant to clause (ii), if multiple adult tenants reside in the unit, the landlord shall return the remainder of the security by a check made payable to all adult tenants on the rental or lease agreement at the time the tenancy terminates

If any remaining portion of the security is to be returned to multiple adult tenants, the landlord may return the security by either a check by first-class mail, postage prepaid, or an electronic deposit to a bank account or other financial institution designated by each adult tenant, as specified in the written agreement.

effect.statement: Return one check payable to all adult tenants on the lease; no electronic refund.

branches.reading: No. Clause (A)(i) and (B)(i) are expressly "subject to subparagraph (C)", but the electronic duty in (A)(ii) is not; the electronic duty applies to payments received electronically regardless of the number of tenants.

authority.quote: Subject to subparagraph (C), and except as provided by clause (ii), the landlord shall return the remainder of the security by personal delivery or by a check made payable to the tenant and mailed by first-class mail, postage prepaid.

If the landlord received the security or rental payments from the tenant electronically, the landlord shall return the remainder of the security electronically to a bank account or other financial institution designated by the tenant in writing

effect.statement: Return electronically to the account designated in writing.
